note: Brief 27, loop 55: one row a loop; lifecycle.mjs joins the rest from the effects matrix.

loops.title: Creation And Starting History
loops.decisions: Who the actor is: name, birth, a citizenship asked apart from the birthplace, a home region and a previous residence, background, genres, wealth and banks.
loops.states: A new save: the history set once at creation, then read by the systems it feeds.
loops.timed: None until the clock starts, paused.
loops.exits: Back between the steps; nothing is written until the life begins.

loops.title: Outstanding Foundation Requirements
loops.decisions: None of the player’s: the rows are proof, decisions and measurements.
loops.states: Each row classified by what it lacks (OUTSTANDING.md).
loops.timed: The final runs measure the 85 again on the finished commit.
loops.exits: A row behind a decision waits on the owner.
loops.why: Area C’s 121 rows: 85 measured again in F, 20 behind a product decision, 4 decisions for the owner, 12 commands no audit has read.

loops.title: Mobile Orientation And Navigation
loops.decisions: Holding the phone either way; every screen usable upright and turned.
loops.states: No gate: the rotate overlay is gone, the layout the same interface in portrait.
loops.exits: Turning back restores the scroll and focus.
loops.entry: Every screen, upright and turned (emulation, not a physical phone).

loops.title: Save, Resume, And Recovery
loops.decisions: Save, load, restore a backup.
loops.states: A save at schema 94, migrated forward from older ones; a cleared slot’s backup listed.
loops.timed: The autosave and the clock’s pending items, kept in the save.
loops.exits: Restore Backup; an older save brought forward.
loops.entry: Save Selection; the save’s way to the server (a fake platform, said as such).

loops.title: Career Readiness While Enrolled
loops.decisions: What to make for a portfolio, whether to ask the School to work in term, which pieces for the showcase.
loops.states: Materials made and versioned; a request pending, approved or refused; the showcase chosen and played.
loops.timed: The dean’s answer a week on; the showcase’s night and its follow-up.
loops.exits: Work taken in term without approval brings an academic warning; a refused request leaves the part to decline.

loops.title: Graduation And Career Transition
loops.decisions: Whether to join SAG-AFTRA once eligible.
loops.states: Graduated at Commencement; Equity by the degree; SAG-AFTRA eligible, then a member.
loops.timed: The last evaluation, Commencement, the union dues each May and November.
loops.exits: Leaving without the degree takes the other way; dues owed are kept as owed.

loops.title: Professional Materials
loops.decisions: What to make, from which recordings, and when to bring the résumé up to date.
loops.states: Each material a numbered version with where it came from; a résumé behind the record says so.
loops.timed: A headshot session in daylight hours; none other.
loops.exits: An older version kept; a submission names the versions it sent.

loops.title: Approaching An Individual Agent
loops.decisions: Which agent, by which way in, what to send, and when to move a meeting.
loops.states: From the notice read to materials sent, waiting, asked for more, a meeting, deciding, and an offer, a pass or no answer.
loops.timed: The office’s answer, a request’s due date, the meeting, the silence after six weeks, a cooldown.
loops.exits: After a pass or no answer, a cooldown and only something new reopens it.

loops.title: Active Representation And Ending Representation
loops.decisions: Accept or decline the agreement; end it by agreement or by its unions’ rules.
loops.states: Offered, accepted, declined, lapsed, ended by term, agreement, no offer or too little work.
loops.timed: The offer’s lapse; the term’s end; Equity’s ninety days, SAG-AFTRA’s 151 and 91.
loops.exits: Commission still owed on work contracted while represented; one agent at a time.

loops.title: Project Development And Opportunity Supply
loops.decisions: None: the world makes the work.
loops.states: Each week’s slate by market and kind; a production made, pushed back or dropped; series seasons ordered or decided.
loops.timed: Monday’s postings; a production’s fate known weeks before its first day.
loops.exits: A pushed part posted again for its new dates.

loops.title: Discovering And Evaluating A Role
loops.decisions: Whether a role suits: its project, part, what it asks, dates, place and pay, and its page in Productions And People.
loops.states: Posted, open until its date.
loops.exits: A role let go lapses unsaid.

loops.title: Submission
loops.decisions: Submit yourself, with what the casting asks for.
loops.states: Open, submitted, then an audition or a pass.
loops.exits: A submission refused names what’s missing and where to make it.

loops.title: Self-Tape
loops.decisions: Prepare the sides by the steps, and tape it before it’s due.
loops.states: An audition set, prepared, taped or missed.
loops.exits: A tape missed closes the round, said.

loops.title: In-Person Audition
loops.decisions: Go when the clock stops; ask once for another time a day ahead.
loops.states: Set, moved once, done or missed.
loops.timed: The audition’s hour, with the trip there.
loops.exits: A clash moved once to a clear time.

loops.title: Callback, Chemistry Read, Or Screen Test
loops.decisions: Go to each round.
loops.states: Audition, callback, chemistry read and screen test, each judged; a hold on the dates from the cut.
loops.timed: Each round’s hour; casting’s decision after the last.
loops.exits: A round slept through ends it.

loops.title: Direct Offer
loops.decisions: Accept or decline an offer made without an audition.
loops.states: Offered, booked, declined or lapsed.
loops.exits: Declining closes it with no penalty beyond the part.

loops.title: Rejection And Recovery
loops.decisions: What to do next: other roles, better materials.
loops.states: Passed or lapsed, kept in the history with why.
loops.exits: Why It Went This Way gives the round’s reasons; the next Monday posts again.

loops.title: Negotiation
loops.decisions: Have the agent ask once for more.
loops.states: The offer versioned, raised or kept.
loops.timed: The answer the next afternoon; the lapse moved past it.
loops.exits: Without an agent nobody asks; a second ask refused.

loops.title: Contract Signing And Booking
loops.decisions: Accept the offer, reading what accepting brings first.
loops.states: Booked: a contract with only the clauses that apply, the work days on the calendar, the pay promised.
loops.timed: The work days; each payment’s due date.
loops.exits: Called off later, what was earned is kept.

loops.title: Holds, Options, And Conflicts
loops.decisions: Ask the production to decide first, or let the hold go for other work.
loops.states: A hold from the cut, booked, let go or withdrawn; a series part’s option taken up or not.
loops.timed: The answer the next afternoon; the option’s last day.
loops.exits: Accepting other work lets the hold go, said before it’s pressed.

loops.title: Role Preparation
loops.decisions: Prepare by each format’s own steps.
loops.states: Preparation levels, revised pages the night before.
loops.timed: The revision the evening before a work day.
loops.exits: Unprepared work is judged lower, said.

loops.title: Work Travel And Arrival
loops.decisions: Apply for the visa; be awake for the car to the airport.
loops.states: A trip booked, departed, arrived, home; a visa pending, granted or refused; a flight missed.
loops.exits: A missed flight books the same flights a day later, or the work goes on without the actor.
loops.notBuilt: A delayed flight: the trip lands a day ahead of the first call, so a delay changes nothing short of a day’s (README, K5).

loops.title: Live-Action Production Day
loops.decisions: Go to each day; ask for another take, use the double.
loops.states: Each day worked, judged and reported; a weather day slips the days.
loops.timed: Each call; the weather the evening before.
loops.exits: A day that can’t slip is shot without the actor.

loops.title: Multi-Camera Or Audience-Based Production
loops.decisions: Each day of the week to the tape night.
loops.states: Table read, rehearsal, blocking, tape night.
loops.exits: A missed day by the medium’s rule.

loops.title: Animation And Voice Work
loops.decisions: Each booth session; a voice demo for voice casting.
loops.states: Sessions worked; voice credits that go on a demo, not a reel.
loops.exits: A pickup session after the wrap.

loops.title: Performance Capture
loops.decisions: Each capture day.
loops.states: Days worked, other characters at no more pay.
loops.exits: A missed day by the medium’s rule.

loops.title: Documentary-Related Performer Work
loops.decisions: Narration or a reenactment.
loops.states: Sessions or days worked; a documentary performer ineligible for performer awards, said.
loops.exits: A missed day by the medium’s rule.

loops.title: Changes, Absence, And Replacement
loops.decisions: Whether to go while unwell.
loops.states: A day missed, covered by an understudy, shot around once, or the actor replaced.
loops.exits: Replacement ends the engagement with the pay earned kept.

loops.title: Wrap And Post-Production Obligations
loops.decisions: Go to the looping session, the reshoot or pickup, the promotional film.
loops.states: Recalled, held against other work, attended or missed.
loops.timed: Each recall a month and a half to three months on.
loops.exits: A missed recall said, its pay not earned.

loops.title: Compensation
loops.decisions: Ask about a late payment.
loops.states: Each payment from estimated to settled, through the agency’s trust account where represented.
loops.timed: The Thursday after each week; late pay’s answer.
loops.exits: A late payment asked about; withholding, dues and commission each shown.
loops.notBuilt: Expense claims and fares to local work: nothing a player pays is a production’s to reimburse; the per diem away is paid once home (README, K5).

loops.title: Residuals Or Contingent Compensation
loops.decisions: None of the player’s.
loops.states: Television work under SAG-AFTRA carries residuals; a rerun pays again.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Work Ending And Money Still Owed
loops.decisions: Ask about what’s owed.
loops.states: Work finished or called off, the earned pay still paid, commission owed after an agreement ends.
loops.exits: A canceled engagement keeps what was earned.

loops.title: Distribution And Release
loops.decisions: None: the distributor decides.
loops.states: Released on time, held back, sent to streaming or shelved, told when due.
loops.timed: The release date; a held-back release put on the clock again.
loops.exits: A shelved credit stays shot, its footage never on a reel.

loops.title: Publicity
loops.decisions: Go to the promotional film.
loops.states: Called, attended or missed.
loops.timed: A weekday a fortnight before the release.
loops.exits: Missing it is said: the visibility it would lend isn’t gained, and its casting office won’t make a direct offer from that work.

loops.title: Weekly Box Office
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: A film in cinemas has a run in the game’s own chart; published charts read as dated imports.
loops.timed: Each week as the clock reaches it.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Weekly Television And Streaming Performance
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: Each season’s audience in its own unit, the game’s estimate.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Long-Term Project History
loops.decisions: Look up any project the career touched.
loops.states: A credit kept for good; a posting, the work and its pay kept while anything to come still reads them, past the 40 latest postings and 20 latest finished engagements (keepBounded); a page reads what the record holds.
loops.exits: A page no longer held says so.
loops.entry: Two long careers (four and four and a half years) walked on the built app at three sizes (emulation, not a physical phone): each project page opened, its company and Back.

loops.title: Renewal Decision
loops.decisions: None: the network decides.
loops.states: Renewed or canceled, reading the last season’s audience, reviews and age.
loops.exits: A canceled series may be revived.

loops.title: Returning Player
loops.decisions: Accept the invitation back.
loops.states: A recurring part optioned, invited, returning.
loops.timed: The option’s day; the next season’s casting.
loops.exits: Renewal never rebooks automatically.

loops.title: New Character On An Existing Series
loops.decisions: Whether to go for a new part in a series already on.
loops.states: A revival’s character plans; a new part posted.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Cancellation And Possible Revival
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: Canceled, future work called off with pay settled; revived years on.
loops.exits: A revival brings the character back by its draw.

loops.title: Festival Submission And Selection
loops.decisions: None: the production submits.
loops.states: Not submitted, submitted, selected, not selected, screened.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Festival Attendance
loops.decisions: None offered.
loops.states: A selected film screens whether or not the actor goes.
loops.exits: None.
loops.why: Not built: going could change only the people met there, which the game keeps no record of beyond an agent’s meetings, and the loop forbids a boost merely for appearing; a choice nothing read would be a declared word (README, K7).

loops.title: Award Eligibility And Submission
loops.decisions: Enter yourself for an Emmy; submit yourself for the Actor Awards.
loops.states: Eligible or refused with the rule’s words; entered or submitted, by you or the production.
loops.timed: The entry deadline; the submission window.
loops.exits: After the deadline nobody can enter.

loops.title: Nomination And Voting
loops.decisions: None: the voters decide.
loops.states: Nominated or not; won or lost at the final round, told at the ceremony.
loops.exits: None.
loops.notBuilt: The player’s own ballot as a member: one vote among the membership’s is a vote the simulated field can’t weigh (README, K7).

loops.title: Ceremony
loops.decisions: Go or watch from home; prepare remarks; go up to accept.
loops.states: Invited, going or watching; the show; a win accepted with a speech, unanswered, or without the actor.
loops.timed: The answer’s day, the trip, the show, the moment to go up.
loops.exits: A missed flight: the win accepted without them.
loops.entry: Played on the built app at three sizes (emulation, not a physical phone) from a long career stopped at an open invitation: one Go To The Ceremony for four nominations, the remarks, 41 stops gone to, the show and three wins accepted; and from the degree career, nine Emmy nominations at one show.

loops.title: Post-Award Career Effects
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: Recognition fades over three years; an agent reads it once; an ask reads visibility.
loops.exits: Nothing stacks for the same award.

loops.title: Interactive Industry Reference
loops.decisions: Which page to open, and where to go to act.
loops.states: A page held or not for this player; the trail of pages followed.
loops.exits: Back and the trail; a page no longer held says so.
loops.entry: Walked on the built app at three sizes from two long careers (emulation, not a physical phone): the front page, a project, its company and Back, an action and the same page on return, a series, season and episode, Find.

loops.title: Actionable Mail And Notices
loops.decisions: Answer a decision; read a notice.
loops.states: A decision open, answered, expired once; a notice read.
loops.exits: Expiry closes it once; reading never accepts an offer.

loops.title: Ongoing Opportunity And Relationship Loop
loops.decisions: Keep submitting; keep the agent relationship.
loops.states: Weekly postings; an agent’s follow-ups and referrals.
loops.exits: Cooldowns end with something new.

loops.title: Persistent State And Event Order
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: Every pending item in the save; each step reads its record before acting.
loops.exits: A reload decides the same.

loops.title: Meaningful Variation
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: The slate’s work by market, kind and season, every draw keyed by what it decides.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Transparency And Player Understanding
loops.decisions: Read why it went as it did; read the guide.
loops.states: Reasons kept per decision; chapters read.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Research And Accuracy
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: Every real fact sourced and dated in the register; what wasn’t read said unread.
loops.exits: None.

loops.title: Coverage And Verification
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: This matrix, the effects matrix, the sweep’s register, the completion matrix.
loops.exits: None.
loops.why: The final runs and the long careers are played again in F.

loops.title: Execution And Completion
loops.decisions: None.
loops.states: Milestones R to K8 built and pushed; F under way.
loops.exits: None.
loops.why: F: the final runs, the gate on the finished commit, the receipt and the handoff.
